Designs a storm sewer network: the design discharge, diameter, slope and depth of each pipe.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** Sewer network, Storm water, Urban hydrology<br>
**Authors:** Daniele Andreis, Rigon Riccardo, David tamanini, Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.TrentoPProject`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inDatabase` | file |  |  | The database of the network, with the layers network_project, areas and junctions and the tables parameters and diameters: a GeoPackage (.gpkg) or H2GIS (.mv.db) file, or a PostGIS database, as jdbc:postgresql://host:port/database. The designed network is written into it, as the layer network_project_output. |
| `pUser` | String |  |  | The optional user of the database. |
| `pPassword` | String |  |  | The optional password of the database. |
| `pOutPipe` | Integer | - |  | The ID of the outlet, the last pipe of the network. |

**References**

- Rodríguez-Iturbe, I., Valdés, J. B. (1979). The geomorphologic structure of hydrologic response. Water Resources Research, 15(6), 1409-1420.
